hooks.command: bash -lc 'repo="${CODEX_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}}"; if [ -n "$repo" ]; then repo="$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; else repo="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; fi && cd "$repo" 2>/dev/null || { printf "%s\n" "Habitat agent-stop hook must run inside the repository worktree." >&2; exit 2; }; bun habitat hook agent-stop'
